description: This file defines the interface 'ModelConditionFactory' which acts as a factory for creating instances of 'ModelCondition' based on provided XML elements and model widgets. It includes a method for instantiating new conditions and references external classes such as 'Element'.

classes.name: ModelConditionFactory
classes.description: An interface serving as a factory for creating 'ModelCondition' instances, typically based on XML configuration and model widgets.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new 'ModelCondition' instance from a given 'ModelWidget' and XML 'Element'. Throws IllegalArgumentException if no model can be associated.
